provenance.scope: A name for every part of every machine, so a tap on the model names the part it lands on and not only a part a step speaks of. Keyed by machine slug and by the part id the machine's own record gives it.
provenance.rule: Each name is the plain word for the part as the machine's record describes it: its material and role in the dossier, the part notes, the mechanism section and the steps. Repeated parts share one name. A body built outside its record keeps these ids, and the vitrine maps them onto its own node names.
